source.title: Every Mac comes with an (undocumented) family member classifier
source.author: infwhispers

title.zh: Apple 知识图谱如何整理人际关系
title.en: Apple Knowledge Graph Maps Personal Relationships

excerpt.zh: Apple 知识图谱被研究者发现会在 Mac 本地整合联系人、日历等信息，记录人际关系与行为线索。相关数据库受系统权限保护，但关系推断的准确性及其被 AI 调用的方式仍待厘清。
excerpt.en: Apple knowledge graph research details local relationship data on Macs, raising questions about inference accuracy and AI access.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Apple 知识图谱记录了什么
text.en: What the Apple knowledge graph records

text.zh: 研究团队 Eighth Rank 报告称，Apple 知识图谱通过 Mac 上的两个后台进程，整理用户、联系人及其相互关系。作者称这些进程自 macOS 13 起随系统提供，但此次分析的数据来自 macOS 26.6.2；这些发现不能直接证明所有版本的行为完全一致。
text.en: Research team Eighth Rank reports that the Apple knowledge graph uses two background processes on Macs to organize information about users, their contacts and their relationships. The authors say the processes have shipped since macOS 13, but their analysis used macOS 26.6.2. The findings therefore do not establish identical behavior across every version.

text.zh: 报告列出的信息来源包括联系人、照片、日历、家人共享，以及 Siri 建议从邮件和信息中发现的事件与联系人。核心数据库以实体和关系组织数据，旁边另有通信记录、位置及设备信号等表。作者强调，所述通信日志记录对象、时间、应用与方向，不含通信正文。
text.en: Reported inputs include Contacts, Photos, Calendar, Family Sharing, and events and contacts identified by Siri Suggestions in Mail and Messages. The central database organizes entities and relationships, while accompanying tables hold communication records, location and device signals. The described communication log records participants, timing, app and direction, without message content.

text.zh: 本地个人数据的价值与边界
text.en: The value and limits of local personal data

text.zh: 把分散信息连成关系网络，可为个性化功能提供上下文，也会让单一存储汇集更多敏感线索。研究者称，这些 SQLite 数据库以明文保存，但所在目录受 TCC 的完全磁盘访问权限保护；明文存储并不等于任意应用都能读取。团队还发布了本地查看工具 iKnow。
text.en: Connecting scattered information could provide context for personalized features while concentrating sensitive clues in one store. The researchers describe plaintext SQLite databases in a directory protected by TCC Full Disk Access controls; plaintext storage does not imply unrestricted access by any app. They also released iKnow, a local tool for inspecting the graph.

text.zh: 关键疑问是：系统如何推断亲属等关系、准确性如何，以及 AI 实际如何使用这些记录。所给材料没有提供亲属分类的准确率，也未证实大语言模型具体如何检索该库。部分数据类型仅发现定义、未观察到记录；作者讨论的数据滥用场景属于思想实验，不能当作已发生的数据泄露。
text.en: Key questions remain about how relationships such as kinship are inferred, how accurate those inferences are, and how AI actually uses the records. The supplied material provides no kinship-classification accuracy figures or confirmation of specific LLM retrieval behavior. Some data types were defined but not observed populated. The authors’ misuse scenario is a thought experiment, not evidence of an actual data breach.
